# Filters

Create and manage stream filters, including MCU-related filter APIs.

Part of the [API Catalog](./). Full schemas: [Swagger](https://antmedia.io/rest/).

## Conventions

| Placeholder | Meaning |
|-------------|---------|
| `{domain}` | Server hostname or IP |
| `{app}` | Application name (often `live`) |
| Path/query placeholders | Match the parameter name in the tables below |

Use port `5080` with `http://` for local HTTP tests.

**Base URL:** `https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/...`

**Auth:** [IP filter](/guides/developer-sdk-and-api/rest-api-guide/securing-rest-apis/) or `-H "Authorization: Bearer {JWTToken}"` — see [Secure with JWT](/guides/developer-sdk-and-api/rest-api-guide/jwt-rest-api-filter/).

:::tip Windows Command Prompt
Escape JSON quotes in `-d` bodies: `-d "{""name"":""My Stream""}"`
:::

## `delete`

[Delete the filter according to the filterId](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/delete)

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `DELETE` | `/rest/v2/filters/{id}` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `id` | path | yes | Filter id for deleting filter |

```bash
curl -X DELETE \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/filters/{id}"
```

## `create`

[Creates or update the filter](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/create)

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `POST` | `/rest/v2/filters/create` |

Request body: Filter object with the updates. See schema in [Swagger](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/create).

```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/filters/create" \
  -d '{}'
```

| `size` | path | yes | Number of items that will be fetched. If there is not enough item in the datastore, returned list size may less then th… |

```bash
curl -X GET \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/filters/list/{offset}/{size}"
```

## `setCustomMCUFilter`

[Set a filter specific to the MCU room](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/setCustomMCUFilter)

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `PUT` | `/rest/v2/filters/mcu-filter` |

```bash

  -d '{}'
```

## `setPluginType`

[Set the plugin type of the MCU function](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/setPluginType)

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `PUT` | `/rest/v2/filters/mcu-plugin-type` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `type` | query | no | Change the plugin type for a filter: synchronous \| asynchronous (default) \| lastpoint |

```bash
curl -X PUT \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/filters/mcu-plugin-type?type={type}"
```

## `createMCU`

[Creates MCU for the roomo in the parameter](https://antmedia.io/rest/#/default/createMCU)

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `POST` | `/rest/v2/filters/room-mcu-filter/{roomId}` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `roomId` | path | yes | Room Id |
| `videoEnabled` | query | no | Video enabled |
| `audioEnabled` | query | no | Audio enabled |

```bash
curl -X POST \
  "https://{domain}:5443/{app}/rest/v2/filters/room-mcu-filter/{roomId}?videoEnabled={videoEnabled}&audioEnabled={audioEnabled}"
```
